SRC-019:R1.text: CORE-001 P1: crew.py crew_release_context / _release_current / _post_ship -- pre-ship evidence is captured for applicable_roles(snapshot) while _release_current validates against the static CREW_ROLES, so a correctly NOT_APPLICABLE saiui makes a no-UI project reject its own release, and _post_ship recomputes applicability against the later mutable tree so release truth is never frozen. Freeze per-role applicability receipts as canonical pre-ship release evidence and validate and certify against that frozen manifest
